nodes.label: SMMAI Plan v3 Dashboard Architecture Review
nodes.rationale: Supersedes dashboard assumptions in v1/v2; inventories the prototype, separates essential vs optional components, and defines the production SMM information architecture.

nodes.label: Recommended v3 Information Architecture
nodes.rationale: Navigation follows user jobs (Content, Engagement, Analytics, Accounts) rather than implementation domains (Architecture Graph, WASM, CRM); System Diagnostics stays developer-only.

nodes.label: Server-Authoritative System Controls
nodes.rationale: Local React state for dryRun/wasmRanking lets the UI claim live publishing changed without backend change; every mutating control must call a server API and return persisted state.

nodes.label: No Widgets Until IA and Data Contracts Defined
nodes.rationale: The most important v3 decision: adding dashboard widgets before core SMM information architecture and data contracts exist multiplies rework on a prototype missing calendars, accounts, inbox, and real publishing.

nodes.label: Workspace to Client Domain Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Agency/multi-client operation must be a first-class hierarchy (Workspace, Client, Brand, Social accounts, Campaigns, Content) rather than a placeholder dashboard section.
